title: Search Typeahead, Deterministic First
description: The search box now suggests from a generated index of page titles and headings: tiered prefix scoring, a 1-edit fuzzy pass on longer queries, and a stable tiebreak, all client-side. Try the dev toggle the Jev demo is built around: deterministic, a ~40 ms System One rerank, or a chat-model baseline, with live p50, p95 and cost.
